correctness.rationale: PASS: For finite Heyting chain H_n the implication table is a->b=top if a<=b else b and pseudocomplement is top only at a=bottom. The WM condition reduces to exactly f=bottom, g=bottom, or both initial values bottom; stars-and-bars counts W_n=T_n²+2(M_n-T_n). IM imposes forbidden band: with h=rank f(top), g(a) has v<h or v=top. The three disjoint cases count to I_n=1+M_n-T_n+sum_h binom(n+h-2,n-2)binom(n+h-1,n-1). The ratio A_(n,h-1)/A_(n,h)=h²/[(n+h-2)(n+h-1)] tends to 1/4 near the terminal term and is bounded by 1/3, proving the 2/3 limit. Brute evaluation of every monotone pair for n=2..5 reproduces (9,6,4),(100,44,29),(1225,430,288),(15876,5012,3377). No optional normal axioms or neighborhood frame converse asserted.
